scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good morning! This is Ms. Patel, our new accountant.
scene.zh: 早安！這位是我們新來的會計 Patel 小姐。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! I'm here two days a week, Tuesdays and Thursdays.
scene.zh: 嗨！我一週來兩天，星期二和星期四。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's a new fiscal year, so you two will do the Lantern budget.
scene.zh: 新的會計年度開始了，所以 Lantern 的預算就交給你們兩個。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for helping me put the budget together.
scene.zh: 謝謝妳幫我一起把預算做出來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Happy to help. I've worked in finance for nearly ten years.
scene.zh: 很樂意。我做財務工作快十年了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How much can we spend on the Lantern series this year?
scene.zh: Lantern 系列今年可以花多少錢？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There's $250,000 in the fund for new products this year.
scene.zh: 今年新產品的經費有二十五萬美元。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay. I'll check our numbers every quarter, not just annually.
scene.zh: 好。我每一季都會看一下數字，不會只有年底才看。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Mr. Ellis wants the financial plan by January 31.
scene.zh: 很好。Ellis 先生要我們一月三十一號前交出財務計畫。

fills.en: Desk lamps ___ $410,000 in revenue last year.
fills.zh: 檯燈去年帶來了四十一萬美元的營收。

fills.en: Everyone was ___ by the low profit margin.
fills.zh: 大家都對這麼低的利潤率感到意外。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, where do you want to begin?
scene.zh: 那，你想從哪裡開始？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's start by looking at last year's numbers.
scene.zh: 我們先從去年的數字看起吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea. Our desk lamps generated $410,000 in revenue.
scene.zh: 好主意。我們的檯燈去年帶來了四十一萬美元的營收。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But sales declined a little in the fall.
scene.zh: 不過秋天的時候銷售下滑了一點。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Our profit margin on the glass lamp was pretty low.
scene.zh: 我們那款玻璃檯燈的利潤率滿低的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. After all the costs, our net profit on it was just eight percent.
scene.zh: 對。扣掉所有成本，它的淨利只有百分之八。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll do a full analysis, so we can assess each lamp.
scene.zh: 我會做一份完整的分析，這樣我們就能評估每一款燈。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then you'll see what percentage of our profit each lamp brings in.
scene.zh: 這樣你就會看到每一款燈占我們利潤的百分比。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's the spreadsheet. Every cost is a separate entry.
scene.zh: 這是試算表。每一筆成本都是單獨一列。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Materials, packaging, utilities, plus the two trade shows.
scene.zh: 材料、包裝、水電，再加上兩場商展。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should delivery costs be included in the spreadsheet too?
scene.zh: 運費也要算進這個試算表裡嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. And Brightway's prices are in Taiwan dollars, so I convert them.
scene.zh: 要。還有，Brightway 的報價是新台幣，所以我會換算。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The rate fluctuates, but one US dollar is equivalent to about 32 Taiwan dollars.
scene.zh: 匯率會波動，不過一美元大約等於三十二元新台幣。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can the total be updated automatically when prices change?
scene.zh: 價格變動的時候，總數可以自動更新嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It can. You don't even need a calculator.
scene.zh: 可以。你連計算機都不用。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It also divides the total by twelve to show each month.
scene.zh: 它還會把總數除以十二，算出每個月的金額。

texts.title: Quarterly Cost Report: October to December
lines: Prepared by Ms. Patel for Harbor Trading
Report date: January 8
Materials: $42,000 (up a little from July to September)
Packaging: $8,500
Travel: $9,600 (two trade shows and one sales trip)
Office and utilities: $6,000
As always, materials were our biggest cost this quarter. Packaging and office costs did not change much.
Travel was higher because of the two trade shows. All travel reimbursements are included.
Next quarter, travel will cost more because of the Lantern launch. Please tell me if any number looks wrong.

texts.title: Travel costs in the quarterly report
lines: Hi,
Thanks for the quarterly report. I read it this morning, and I found a discrepancy.

The reimbursement for Dan's December sales trip ($1,800) was entered twice, so the travel number is too high. Please deduct it from the travel total. I already told Dan about it. Everything else looks right to me, and the report is very clear.
Could you and Ms. Patel fix this before the audit on February 10? Please send me the new total when it's ready.
I copied Ms. Patel on this email so she can see it too.
Thanks,
Ms. Carter

questions.en: What months does the report cover?
questions.zh: 這份報告涵蓋哪幾個月？

questions.en: Why did Ms. Carter write the email?
questions.zh: Carter 小姐為什麼寫這封信？

questions.en: What is the correct travel cost?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you get my email about the quarterly report?
scene.zh: 你有收到我寄的那封季報 email 嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Our travel expenditure looks way too high.
scene.zh: 我們的差旅支出看起來高太多了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It looks like the travel costs were counted twice.
scene.zh: 看起來差旅費好像被算了兩次。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's what I thought. The reimbursement for Dan's trip went in twice.
scene.zh: 我也是這麼想。Dan 出差的報銷被輸入了兩次。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's not a substantial sum, but the audit is on February 10.
scene.zh: 金額不算大，不過二月十號就要查帳了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Even a slight mistake looks bad in an audit.
scene.zh: 就算是小錯，查帳時也很難看。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Can you and Ms. Patel fix it this week?
scene.zh: 你和 Patel 小姐這個禮拜可以把它改好嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And check Brightway's rebate while you're at it.
scene.zh: 順便也查一下 Brightway 的退款。

lines.en: Desk lamp sales have two peaks every year.
lines.zh: 檯燈的銷售每年有兩個高峰。

lines.en: August, before school starts, and November, before Christmas.
lines.zh: 八月開學前，還有十一月聖誕節前。

lines.en: And what's your assumption for this year?
lines.zh: 那妳對今年的假設是什麼？

lines.en: Steady growth of about six percent, plus Lantern after May.
lines.zh: 大約百分之六的穩定成長，五月以後再加上 Lantern。
有什麼會改變這個數字嗎？

lines.en: A sudden change in the Taiwan dollar would affect our costs.
lines.zh: 新台幣如果突然變動，會影響我們的成本。

lines.en: So many factors determine the final number. It's hard to predict.
lines.zh: 最後的數字由太多因素決定，很難預測。

lines.en: I'd rather keep the forecast low and do better than expected.
lines.zh: 我寧可預估保守一點，最後做得比預期好。

lines.en: Okay. Then I'll use five percent.

questions.en: How much growth does Ms. Patel expect?
questions.zh: Patel 小姐預估成長多少？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, the sales forecast is ready. Want to see it?
scene.zh: 好，銷售預估做好了。要看看嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What factors did you include in the sales forecast?
scene.zh: 妳在銷售預估裡考慮了哪些因素？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Last year's sales, our two peak months, and the May launch.
scene.zh: 去年的銷售、兩個旺季月份，還有五月上市。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My assumption is steady growth, about six percent.
scene.zh: 我的前提是穩定成長，大約百分之六。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But a sudden change in prices could affect everything.
scene.zh: 不過價格要是突然變動，一切都會受影響。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd rather keep the forecast low and do better than expected.
scene.zh: 我寧可預估保守一點，最後做得比預期好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fair enough. It's hard to predict a new series anyway.
scene.zh: 有道理。反正新系列本來就很難預測。

textFills.title: Changes to the Lantern budget
lines: Hi everyone,
Material costs have gone ___ nearly ten percent, so our total was $18,000 over budget.
To close the gap, we will ___ less money to the trade show and make fewer samples.
Ms. Carter says the new total is acceptable.
Ms. Patel
zh: 材料成本漲了將近一成，所以我們的總數超出預算一萬八千美元。
為了補上這個缺口，我們會少撥一點錢給商展，樣品也會少做一些。
高級款會等到明年再做。
Carter 小姐說新的總數可以接受。

blanks.note: 把錢撥給某個用途：allocate ... to。

options: The premium model will wait until next year.
We will add three more trade shows.
Please make more samples this year.
Material costs have gone down a lot.
blanks.note: 要省錢，所以高級款延到明年。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, how's the budget looking?
scene.zh: 那，預算看起來怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not great. It all adds up to $268,000.
scene.zh: 不太好。全部加起來是二十六萬八千美元。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's $18,000 over. Where's that gap coming from?
scene.zh: 超出一萬八千美元。這個缺口是哪裡來的？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Material costs have gone up nearly ten percent.
scene.zh: 材料成本漲了將近一成。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And shipping prices vary a lot between companies.
scene.zh: 而且每家貨運公司的運費差很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We can't withdraw from the trade show. What else can we eliminate?
scene.zh: 商展不能退出。還有什麼可以砍掉的？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: What I'd suggest is cutting back on samples for the trade show.
scene.zh: 我的建議是，商展要用的樣品少做一點。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fifty samples would be sufficient.
scene.zh: 五十個樣品就夠了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. And let's freeze the premium model until next year.
scene.zh: 很好。高級款也先暫停，等明年再說。

lines.en: Good afternoon. Here is today's business news.
lines.zh: 午安，以下是今天的財經新聞。

lines.en: The US economy grew by about two percent last year.
lines.zh: 美國經濟去年成長了大約百分之二。

lines.en: People also spent a record nine hundred billion dollars over the holidays.
lines.zh: 假期期間，民眾的消費也創下九千億美元的紀錄。

lines.en: However, analysts anticipate a slower year.
lines.zh: 不過，分析師預期今年會比較慢。

lines.en: Prices are still going up, and inflation is high in Europe, where some analysts warn of a recession.
lines.zh: 物價還在上漲，歐洲的通膨很高，有些分析師警告那裡可能會經濟衰退。

lines.en: Many people are moving their money into safer assets.
lines.zh: 很多人正把錢轉到比較安全的資產。

lines.en: The Taiwan dollar has risen against the US dollar, so goods from Taiwan cost more.
lines.zh: 新台幣對美元升值，所以台灣來的貨變貴了。

lines.en: Still, most analysts expect an economic recovery in the second half of the year.
lines.zh: 不過，大部分分析師預期下半年經濟會復甦。

questions.en: How much did the US economy grow last year?
questions.zh: 美國經濟去年成長了多少？

questions.en: What do analysts expect this year?
questions.zh: 分析師預期今年會怎樣？

questions.en: Why do goods from Taiwan cost more?
questions.zh: 為什麼台灣來的貨變貴了？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Was that the business news just now?
scene.zh: 剛剛那是財經新聞嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I missed it. Anything about the economy?
scene.zh: 我沒聽到。有講到經濟嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: A slower economy could mean fewer orders this year.
scene.zh: 經濟放緩的話，今年的訂單可能會變少。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Maybe. Analysts always worry. They said the same thing last year.
scene.zh: 也許吧。分析師總是在擔心，去年他們也這樣說。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The Taiwan dollar worries me more than inflation.
scene.zh: 比起通膨，我更擔心新台幣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We pay Brightway in their currency, so every lamp costs us more.
scene.zh: 我們付給 Brightway 的是他們的貨幣，所以每盞燈都要多花一點。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Material costs have gone up nearly ten percent.
scene.zh: 材料成本漲了將近一成。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. Let's keep some extra money for that, just in case.
scene.zh: 對。我們留一點錢備用，以防萬一。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mr. Ellis will ask about it on Friday, so be ready.
scene.zh: Ellis 先生星期五會問這件事，你要準備好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, $250,000 for Lantern. That's a big investment.
scene.zh: 所以，Lantern 要二十五萬美元。這是一筆不小的投資。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let me show you where every dollar is going.
scene.zh: 我跟您說明一下每一塊錢會花在哪裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Go ahead. I need every cost justified.
scene.zh: 請說。每一筆成本都要有合理的理由。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Still, a new series is always a risk.
scene.zh: 不過，新系列總是有風險。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I think the risk is worth it, and here's why.
scene.zh: 我認為這個風險值得冒，原因是這樣的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I like that. You kept the forecast low and minimized the costs.
scene.zh: 這樣很好。你把預估做得保守，成本也壓到最低。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We have the capital, too. No loan, no new debt.
scene.zh: 而且我們有資金，不用貸款，也不會多出負債。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: All right, you have my authorization. Lantern launches in May.
scene.zh: 好，我核准了。Lantern 五月上市。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Before you see Mr. Ellis, let's do a quick practice.
scene.zh: 你去見 Ellis 先生之前，我們先快速練習一次。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I printed the spreadsheet for both of you.
scene.zh: 我幫你們兩個都印了試算表。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for helping me put the budget together.
scene.zh: 謝謝妳幫我一起把預算做出來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, let's begin. Why do we need a new series at all?
scene.zh: 好，開始吧。我們到底為什麼需要新系列？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Our profit margin on the glass lamp was pretty low.
scene.zh: 我們那款玻璃檯燈的利潤率滿低的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fair. And why is travel lower than in the quarterly report?
scene.zh: 有道理。那差旅費為什麼比季報上的低？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It looks like the travel costs were counted twice.
scene.zh: 看起來差旅費好像被算了兩次。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We fixed it before the audit. It's $7,800 now.
scene.zh: 我們在查帳前改好了，現在是七千八百美元。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. But the materials line looks really high.
scene.zh: 很好。不過材料那一行看起來很高。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Material costs have gone up nearly ten percent.
scene.zh: 材料成本漲了將近一成。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I see. And your sales forecast seems low to me.
scene.zh: 了解。還有，我覺得你的銷售預估有點低。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd rather keep the forecast low and do better than expected.
scene.zh: 我寧可預估保守一點，最後做得比預期好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Why so careful?
scene.zh: 為什麼這麼保守？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: A slower economy could mean fewer orders this year.
scene.zh: 經濟放緩的話，今年的訂單可能會變少。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Also, Brightway's prices change with the Taiwan dollar.
scene.zh: 還有，Brightway 的價格會跟著新台幣變動。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can the total be updated automatically when prices change?
scene.zh: 價格變動的時候，總數可以自動更新嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It already is, remember? I set that up last week.
scene.zh: 已經是了，記得嗎？我上週就設定好了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Mr. Ellis always asks where the money goes.
scene.zh: 很好。Ellis 先生一定會問錢都花到哪裡去。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let me show you where every dollar is going.
scene.zh: 我跟您說明一下每一塊錢會花在哪裡。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Perfect. And if Lantern does well, there'll be a team bonus. Good incentive, right?
scene.zh: 很好。而且如果 Lantern 賣得好，團隊會有獎金喔。很有動力吧？
